integrity: The proof is analytic; bundled finite prime-field checker is reproducible supporting evidence, not an infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unit-edge shortest-path distance of point–hyperplane graphs in finite projective spaces, for all prime powers and dimensions at least two. Earlier projective-plane cases are not new. Undetected equivalent historical treatments remain possible; no independent validation has occurred.
title: A binary characteristic phase transition in projective incidence Gaussian kernels
